title: Reinforcement Learning via Fixed-point Flow Matching
abstract: arXiv:2610.12848v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: In maximum entropy and behavior-constrained reinforcement learning (RL), the optimal policy is given by a Boltzmann distribution. Generating samples from this distribution can be challenging, as it is often complex and multimodal. While flow policies trained with flow matching provide a powerful framework for representing such distributions, they traditionally rely on access to training data, which is generally unavailable in online RL. To address this limitation, we propose fixed-point flow matching (FFM), a data-free procedure for training and fine-tuning flow policies in RL. FFM leverages the target flow identity to formulate the actor update as a fixed-point iteration, utilizing a flow-matching-style regression objective where the critic's action gradients serve as regression targets. translated_title: 基于不动点流匹配的强化学习
translated_abstract: 在最大熵和行为约束强化学习（RL）中，最优策略由玻尔兹曼分布给出。从该分布中生成样本可能具有挑战性，因为它通常复杂且具有多峰性。虽然通过流匹配训练的流策略为表示此类分布提供了强大的框架，但它们传统上依赖于对训练数据的访问，而在线强化学习中通常无法获得训练数据。为了解决这一局限，我们提出了不动点流匹配（FFM），这是一种在强化学习中训练和微调流策略的无数据方法。FFM利用目标流恒等式将actor更新表述为不动点迭代，采用流匹配式的回归目标，其中critic的动作梯度作为回归目标。我们证明最优策略是该迭代的不动点。通过大量实验，我们证明FFM能够有效微调预训练的流策略。
tldr: 本文提出了一种无需数据的不动点流匹配（FFM）方法，通过将actor更新表述为不动点迭代、以critic的动作梯度作为回归目标，实现了强化学习中流策略的训练与微调。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes Fixed-point Flow Matching (FFM), a data-free method that formulates actor updates as a fixed-point iteration using critic action gradients as regression targets, enabling training and fine-tuning of flow policies in reinforcement learning.
